page.search_description_1: The local businesses backing Hendricks Avenue Elementary in 2025-26, grouped by sponsorship level.

section_1.paragraph_1: Every one of them chose to put money into a public elementary school in San Marco. They are on the t-shirts, the marquee, and both entrances — and they are here, which is the least we can do.

section_2.note_1: The Friends Circle is listed by name because this level does not include a logo.

section_3.paragraph_1: With every step our students take, your business will be recognized as a leader walking alongside them.
